about.line.additional_windows: Additional numbers — longer windows and model-specific limits
about.line.warning_icon: Yellow  — data may be outdated (repeated refresh failures)
about.line.normal: Normal  — usage is within comfortable limits
about.line.red: Red       — projected ≥ 120% at reset, or blocked (100%)
about.line.shows_usage: The menu bar shows your Claude usage as percentages.
about.line.stale_prefix: Bold exclamation — recent updates failed; values shown are dimmed and may be outdated.
about.secondary.100_percent_explain: If any usage window reaches 100%, Claude Monitor shows a 🛑 stop icon and replaces percentages by a countdown until the limit clears. A sound plays when a critical limit resets (configurable in Preferences).
about.secondary.additional_explain: Longer windows and model-specific limits appear only when usage is significant and outpacing the remaining time. If a model-specific limit triggers, its all-models counterpart is also shown for context.
about.secondary.outpacing: "Projected at reset" means your current average rate × remaining time, predicting where utilization will be when the window resets.
about.secondary.refresh_explain: Claude Monitor adapts its refresh rate based on activity. It checks frequently when usage is changing, slows down when usage is stable, and reduces to minimal checks when your Mac is idle. Use Refresh Now (⌘R) for an immediate update.
about.secondary.usage_graph_explain: Click any usage row in the menu to see a history graph. The graph tracks utilization over time and shows projection trends.
